find:
const tank = world.tanks.find((t) => t.id === tankId);
    return tank?.kind === 'player' ? tank.controlledBy ?? 0 : null;
replace:
const tank = world.tanks.find((t) => t.id === tankId);
    return tank ? tank.controlledBy ?? 0 : null;
killedBy: tallyVersusAccuracy: the versus result table's accuracy column (issue #279) ignores a NON-PLAYER tank, and does nothing at all outside a versus mode
why: Drops the player-kind guard, so any non-player tank's shots land in a slot -- and with `controlledBy` absent on every non-player tank, all of it falls to `?? 0` and silently inflates Player 1. NOT about bots: a bot DRIVING a versus slot is a player-kind tank with a real `controlledBy` and is counted deliberately. The guard is structural rather than live, because ffa/teams strip every non-player spawn (arena.ts), so this is the known-bad control the guard needs -- it keeps the contract independent of which spawn letters a future arena admits, which is the same reason `tallyCoopKills` carries the rule.
